Question: Mr. Lopez has a choice of two routes to get to work. Route A is \(6\) miles long, and his average speed along this route is \(30\) miles per hour. Route B is \(5\) miles long, and his average speed along this route is \(40\) miles per hour, except for a \(\tfrac{1}{2}\)-mile stretch in a school zone where his average speed is \(20\) miles per hour. By how many minutes is Route B quicker than Route A?
